title: Working days
description:
Write `public static class Calendar` with:

- `public static int WorkingDays(DateOnly from, DateOnly to)`: the number of days from `from` up to but not including `to` that are Monday to Friday; 0 when `to` is not after `from`.
- `public static DateOnly AddWorkingDays(DateOnly start, int days)`: the date `days` working days after `start` (skipping weekends); `days` must be 0 or more, otherwise `ArgumentOutOfRangeException`. With 0, a weekend start moves to the next Monday.
hints: `d.DayOfWeek is not (DayOfWeek.Saturday or DayOfWeek.Sunday)` is a neat working-day test (lessons 8.02 and 8.04).
`DateOnly` values compare with `<`, and `AddDays(1)` moves to the next day.
